decision.reason: [ev-23440109b3b5] is a one-line changelog headline. It says that cache keys are now aligned with a "custom ingester query split" so results are cached correctly. It doesn't name the configuration setting that turns on the custom split, so the evidence can't say which environments are exposed. It also doesn't describe what went wrong before (for example, wrong or stale cached results) or what an operator would see after upgrading. Instead it points to PR 11679 and #11535, so the PR text or the documentation for the split setting is needed before the applicability and consequence can be written.
